name: SpaceX
look: Pure black with full-bleed imagery, uppercase display with positive tracking, and a single ghost-outlined pill per band.

hero.title: ORBITAL
hero.sub: Reusable launch vehicles delivering payloads to orbit at a published price per kilogram. Two hundred and forty consecutive successful landings.

features.title: Reuse is the whole economics
features.sub: An expendable rocket throws away the most expensive part of the mission on every flight.

items.title: Reusable boosters
items.body: Recovered, inspected and reflown, with individual boosters exceeding twenty flights.

items.title: 14-day turnaround
items.body: From landing to the next launch, which is what makes the cadence possible.

items.title: Rideshare
items.body: A published slot price per kilogram for smallsats on scheduled missions.

items.title: Precision insertion
items.body: Orbital insertion accuracy inside a hundred metres of the target.

items.title: Crew rated
items.body: Human-rated for orbital flight, with abort capability through the whole ascent.

items.title: Constellation
items.body: Low-latency broadband from low earth orbit, serving where fibre will not reach.

showcases.title: Fully reusable, both stages
showcases.body: The booster and the upper stage both return. Full reuse is the step that moves cost per kilogram by an order of magnitude rather than a percentage, and it is the reason the vehicle looks the way it does.

showcases.title: Broadband from low orbit
showcases.body: Satellites at five hundred kilometres, low enough that latency is comparable to terrestrial broadband, in numbers sufficient for continuous coverage anywhere on the surface.

testimonial.quote: They published the price per kilogram. Our entire mission architecture changed the week we could actually plan a budget around a number rather than a negotiation.
testimonial.name: Dr Helena Vasquez

pricing.title: LAUNCH SERVICES
pricing.sub: Published pricing. No negotiation required to plan a mission.

items.a: Yes, per kilogram for rideshare and per launch for dedicated missions. Mission-specific integration costs are quoted separately and itemised.

items.q: How reliable is a reflown booster?
items.a: Reflown boosters have a better record than new ones, because a booster that has flown has demonstrably survived the conditions rather than only been modelled against them.
Rideshare slots are typically six to nine months out on the published cadence. Dedicated missions depend on integration complexity and are scheduled individually.

items.q: What insertion accuracy can I plan for?
items.a: Within a hundred metres of the target orbit. The dispersion statistics from previous missions are published rather than summarised.

cta.title: BOOK A LAUNCH
cta.sub: Published pricing, a scheduled cadence, and slots available within the year.

notes: A single pure-black canvas carries every marketing surface. Light appears only on the shop site.
Display is uppercase with positive horizontal tracking — around 1.6px at 80px — which is the typographic signature.
Full-bleed photography or video dominates, and type sits directly on the imagery with no scrim.
One ghost-outlined pill CTA per band. It is never filled and never takes an accent colour.
All chrome microtext is uppercase with positive tracking. Every small label in this system shouts in caps.
